question: Before implementing a complete 41-target lowering bridge, does the real calibration graph surface contain at least one connected mapped subgraph with an exact frozen v5.1 constructor histogram and the constructor-specific dataflow adjacency needed for a nonreference alternative?

enumeration.nodes: call_function nodes whose frozen A1 mapping has a non-null Operator-v5 runtime operation
enumeration.edges: undirected data dependencies between eligible call_function nodes
enumeration.deduplication: artifact id plus sorted FX node names

semantic_adjacency.dense_matrix_chain: one mapped matmul result is a direct argument of the second mapped matmul
semantic_adjacency.fold_conv_batch_norm: the mapped conv2d result is the first tensor argument of the mapped inference batch-normalization call
semantic_adjacency.graph_reassociation: mapped sparse_mm feeds one mapped matmul; mapped sparse_mm and the other mapped matmul reach the mapped add according to the frozen graph-reassociation shape
semantic_adjacency.mamba_composition: one mapped linear feeds three mapped split_get nodes; one split result feeds the second mapped linear; that linear plus two other split results feed mapped cat
semantic_adjacency.primitive_layer_norm: the two mapped reductions and mapped rsqrt form the frozen mean, centered-square-mean, rsqrt dependency chain
semantic_adjacency.stencil_convolution: four mapped rolls of one source feed the two mapped multiplications in the frozen stencil dependency shape

decision_rule.on_positive_semantic_candidate: Freeze a pattern-first A1 typed lowering implementation for the reachable constructor family; keep all other unsupported operations fail-closed or reference-only until separately lowered.
decision_rule.on_zero_semantic_candidates: Reject implementation of the current A1 bridge as unjustified busywork and redesign the A1 control before expanding the runtime vocabulary.
